items.headline: NFL to review additional allegations against Packers RB Josh Jacobs
items.description: The NFL said it will look into additional allegations of physical and verbal abuse by Packers RB Josh Jacobs that were revealed as part of a public records release from the Hobart/Lawrence Police Department.

items.headline: Records show 3 other women accused Packers' Josh Jacobs of abuse after arrest
items.description: Three other women contacted police to detail allegations of abuse against Packers RB Josh Jacobs following his May arrest for an altercation with his then-girlfriend.
